attempts.prompt: Edit this overhead map of a Japanese company island, keeping its cute flat-shaded 3D style, camera direction and daylight. Keep the navy station on the left, its single monorail approach and covered bridge into the tall head-office tower, and the central fountain square with its blue-roofed canteen. Fill the workplace district behind the tower and canteen with several additional office blocks and narrow connected streets. Expand the small teal shop row below the square into a compact shopping neighbourhood: two intersecting pedestrian shopping streets lined on both sides with small varied storefronts and awnings, keeping the dark-roofed bar. Add a clearly visible outdoor lap pool beside the sage-roofed gym, keeping its sports court and nearby university courtyard. Extend the right shoreline slightly into a rocky headland with a small tiled-roof onsen bathhouse and outdoor stone hot-spring pools overlooking the sea. Add a sandy beach cove along the lower-left shore with steps down from the waterfront promenade. Keep the tight tall dorm cluster at lower right and connect every new place to the existing pedestrian paths. Show the whole expanded island with water around it; no text or interface.
